note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the actual inputs.

Please paste:
- The full transcript of the patient encounter
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format

Once provided, I will produce:
- Consult Summary (two-line)
- Problem List with Issue 1–3 (including timeline, symptoms, systems review, social history, medications, examinations, and differential diagnoses from the DDx that are consistent with the transcript, each with Likelihood and a one-line justification)
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks (as specified)

Notes on how I will handle data:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary clinical source and reference the DDx only to support differential considerations if consistent.
- I will not invent data (e.g., vitals or lab values) beyond what is present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Please provide the needed content to proceed.
